bounded_conclusions: The B3 prescribed-head corrector admissibility set is deterministic on the preregistered grid but is not a simple monotone interval around the accepted head.
Valid and invalid heads alternate at picometre-scale offsets; the nearest sampled invalid head is 0.5 pm from the CURRENT_PLUS_U accepted head.
The MAP05 INTERCEPT_ONLY failed head reproduces status 6 in fresh-process trials, so the failure is not caused by accumulated outer-coupling history.
The fragmented topology is numerical/component-domain evidence, not evidence of discontinuous physical hydrology.
Slope policy can affect robustness by steering the coupling path through this structured admissibility set even when alternative nonzero slopes converge to essentially the same accepted physics.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer a physical head tolerance from picometre grid spacing.
Do not adaptively expand or shrink the corrector envelope from MAP06.
No production coupling change follows from MAP06 alone.
